cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_kddockwidgets_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_KDD_CMAKE_ROOT}/KDDockWidgets-qt6Config.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_KDD_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit KDDockWidgets package directory")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6/Qt6Config.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit Qt Base lib/cmake directory")
endif()
foreach(component Core CoreTools Gui GuiTools Widgets WidgetsTools Test)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing explicit Qt component: ${component}")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets Test
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
set(KDDockWidgets-qt6_DIR "${SH3_KDD_CMAKE_ROOT}")
find_package(KDDockWidgets-qt6 2.4.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED
  PATHS "${SH3_KDD_CMAKE_ROOT}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
add_executable(kdw_consumer consumer.cpp)
target_link_libraries(kdw_consumer PRIVATE KDAB::kddockwidgets Qt6::Test)
target_compile_options(kdw_consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
foreach(case docking tabs lifecycle memory file invalid missing)
  add_test(NAME kdw_${case} COMMAND kdw_consumer ${case})
  set_tests_properties(kdw_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30
    ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endforeach()
if(SH3_PROVIDER_SOURCE)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/includes_test/main.cpp")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing original includes_test source")
  endif()
  # Execute the original provider CMake target and main.cpp, unchanged.
  add_subdirectory("${SH3_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/includes_test" provider)
  add_test(NAME provider_includes COMMAND includes_test)
  set_tests_properties(provider_includes PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
endif()
